title: Custom Bed Recipe
description: This mod makes it so that you dont need wool for beds
body:
This mod was made so that you don't have to run around your enitre world to find 3 sheep to make a bed.

## Features
An additional recipe for beds

This mod is intended for singleplayer but can be used in multiplayer if the server/hoster has it installed.

Credit to MCreator for being a thing for me to use.
